description: Set who can see one recipe, menu or list, or the default for NEW recipes. mode: status (read-only), group, all_groups (incl. groups joined later), members (people across the user's groups), private (unshare). Shares link to the original, not copies. Group owners may re-share recipes shared with them. Home Cook and read-only accounts can't. Returns {done, id, title, shared_with} (status: current mode and groups).

default.description: true (no id): read or set the sharing default for new recipes

group.description: mode=group: group names or ids, e.g. ["Family"]

members.description: mode=members: display names, e.g. ["Mom"]; only the user's own groups are matched

mode.description: Sharing to apply; status just reads it

name: share_with_family
title: Share with my group
